name: Formal RFQ (the one we tested before)
text:
REQUEST FOR QUOTATION
RFQ No: RFQ-2026-0457
Buyer: Gulf Industrial Supplies LLC
Issued: 10 November 2026. Quotations due by 25 November 2026, 5 PM GST.

Please quote for the following, delivered to Jebel Ali Free Zone, Dubai by 20 December 2026:
1. Stainless steel pipes, 304 grade, 2 inch diameter - 500 meters
2. Industrial safety gloves, cut-resistant level 5 - 200 pairs
3. Hydraulic hose assemblies, 3/4 inch, 10 meter length - 40 pieces

Payment terms: Net 45 days. Prices in USD.
Suppliers must hold ISO 9001 certification and provide material test certificates.

name: Informal email-style RFQ
text:
Subject: Quote request - office furniture

Hi team,

Acme Trading FZE needs quotes for the items below. Reference: ACM/RFQ/118.
The deadline for your quotation is 30 Nov 2026 at noon.
We need delivery to our warehouse in Sharjah by 15 January 2027.

- Office desks, 1.6m, walnut finish: 25 units
- Ergonomic chairs with lumbar support: 60 units
- Filing cabinets, 4 drawer, steel: 15 units

Payment: 30 days after invoice. Please quote in AED.
All goods must carry a 2-year warranty and be CE marked.

Regards,
Procurement Team, Acme Trading FZE
